settings.title: Brake signal source

options.title: Native OEM signals only (Option 1: ITM_HSCANService + brake.pressure)
Native OEM signals + CAN speed deceleration fallback (regen >= threshold)

settings.description: Option 1 reads native telematics CAN signals directly from tm_hscan_service and HMG-API brake.pressure. Choose the fallback mode if your firmware does not expose regenerative stop-lamp state or IEB cylinder pressure during pure regen.

settings.title: When brake lights are off
settings.description: Controls whether the top-bar icon disappears completely or stays faintly visible as a dark-grey outline when unlit.

settings.title: Top-bar horizontal anchor
settings.description: Selects which edge of the top row x_offset is measured from.

settings.title: Horizontal offset (px)
settings.description: Distance in pixels from the anchor (for Top center, signed offset from center). Default 260 sits cleanly to the left of the clock and status icons on 1920x720 screens.

settings.title: Vertical offset from top (px)
settings.description: Distance in pixels from the top edge of the screen.

settings.title: Icon height (px)
settings.description: Height of the top-bar brake lamp icon in pixels (20 to 96; stock Gen5W status icons are 36 px tall).

settings.title: Brake pressure threshold (tenths)
settings.description: Minimum getCylPrsrVal / brake.pressure reading in tenths (15 = 1.5) to treat hydraulic/IEB braking as active.

settings.title: Regen deceleration threshold (tenths of m/s^2)
settings.description: Minimum deceleration in tenths of m/s^2 (13 = 1.3 m/s^2, UNECE R13-H stop-lamp threshold) when signal_mode includes deceleration fallback.

settings.title: Record ITM_HSCANService candidate transitions
settings.description: Logs read-only brake/stop-lamp getter transitions from com.hkmc.ext.hcan.jar for on-car Option 1 verification and USB export.
